- memory_id "1000067": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000048": As of 2025-01-09, Farah runs the Dune team solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000081": As of 2025-01-09, Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.  (about: Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000061": The Boreal team owns the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000077": As of 2025-01-09, Lena has the Boreal pager first.  (about: Boreal team, Lena)
